text.en:
[ ] No. S 108

THE CONSTITUTION OF

THE STATE OF BRUNEI, 1959 Date for the coming into force of Part IX of the

STATE CONSTITUTION In exercise of the powers vested in him by subsection 2 of Section 1 of the Constitution of the State of Brunei, 1959, His Highness the Sultan hereby appoints the 1st day of January, 1962, as the date for the coming into force of Part IX of the State Constitution.

RAJA AZAM BIN RAJA KAMARULZAMAN State Secretary, Brunei.
